items.title: System design kya hai aur interview mein kya test hota hai
items.one_idea: System design means choosing the parts of a system and how they connect to meet requirements at a given scale; the reel teaches a commonly taught order for answering: requirements and scale, high-level design, component detail, trade-offs.
items.spoken_hook: Interviewer ने पूछा: एक नया app design करना है, तुम सबसे पहले क्या करोगे?
items.hook_formula: interviewer_asked: Interviewer ने पूछा opener with one self-contained question (first-day side-by-side test)
items.visual_idea: A blank whiteboard with a question mark; random boxes are drawn and crossed out in red. Then one running example, a food-delivery app (EXAMPLE), is built in four steps on the same board: a requirements checklist, a users-to-requests number, boxes joined by arrows, then a balance scale FRESH vs FAST.
items.everyday_anchor: Planning a wedding or a trip: ask guest count and budget before picking venue and caterer.
items.example: EXAMPLE: food-delivery app. 1,00,000 orders a day / 86,400 s = about 1.16 orders per second (EXAMPLE pill, arithmetic on screen). Trade-off: menu from cache (fast, a few minutes stale) vs database (fresh, slower).
facts_to_verify: Primer's four steps: use cases/constraints, high level design, core components, scale; say 'a commonly taught order'.
Never say interviewers test/check these four things as fact.
